author: fDhc
content: Result: M8 civilization base fully implemented - settlements (Poisson-disk on score field with 6 weighted components), trade routes (Dijkstra with terrain weights), language families (proper morphological grammar with phoneme inventories, syllable templates, morphological rules, per-family sound-change history). Worker API, Globe layer toggles, IDB persistence, 37 new tests all passing. 386 total tests, clean tsc.
